text:
sam: Heads up — after the KMS alias rotation at 07:30 we see missing audit entries for RBAC role changes in prod. UI shows role updates but kibana/audit pipeline has zero events for those role_change ops. SCIM incoming webhooks show intermittent 500s.

maria: omg, can you paste the SCIM error and any correlation id? @raj oncall?

sam: here's the SCIM handler log (trimmed):
```
2026-03-22T07:31:12Z WARN scim-handler: 500 POST /scim/v2/Groups  - body=... correlation_id=cor-7f9a3
error: KMS: DECRYPT failed: envelope-decryption: invalid encryption context
stack: .../kms/wrapper.go:87
```

raj: we rotated key alias redwood-prod-kms -> alias/redwood-prod-2026-03-22 at 07:30. idp-bot confirmed deploy. Might be context mismatch: we include group_id in encryption context and alias metadata changed. Did you see 'invalid encryption context' consistently for same correlation id?

sam: yes, same correlation_id cor-7f9a3 repeated across retries. SCIM retries 3x then drops. UI shows role change succeeded (service returns 200 after retry) but audit pipeline consumed nothing.

maria: likely two issues: 1) KMS decrypt failures caused the audit publisher to fail to parse payload so it didn't emit event; 2) SCIM handler retries masked source of truth. Steps: capture raw scim body, re-run decryption against old key material, and check kinesis DLQ for failed audit messages.

raj: checking kinesis stream, found ~24 failed records with shardId-11 and error 'invalid-kms-context'. DLQ contains json with "encrypted_event":true and correlation_id cor-7f9a3.

alice: quick mitigation: rebind alias to previous key id to allow decrypt until we re-encrypt. That will restore audit consumer. But prefer minimal blast radius. We can also patch audit publisher to fallback to logging payload base64 for later replay.

sam: can we do timed alias rollback for 30m? Oncall, please coordinate with infra. If rollback not possible, we need to pull DLQ and re-decrypt offline.

raj: I'm on it. Opening infra runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation — will attempt alias swap after 2 approvals. tagging @maria for approval.

maria: approved. do it but add feature-flag to prevent future rotations without ctx migration. :thumbsup:

idp-bot: Deploy bot: kms-rotation job completed for alias/redwood-prod-2026-03-22 at 07:30 by infra-ops.

sam: putting incident label and will open an incident ticket. brief summary for PagerDuty: 'SSO/SCIM RBAC audit missing after KMS alias rotation; audit publisher failed to decrypt payload -> DLQ'.

alice: add timeline and affected customers (internal SSO only). I'll start compose incident doc.

sam: thanks. I'll export DLQ and attach to the ticket. low-risk rollback window requested.

raj: rollback started at 07:52, verifying audit consumer now.

sam: audit events resumed. verifying completeness.

maria: confirm with spot-check query:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM audit_events
WHERE event_type='role_change' AND timestamp >= '2026-03-22T07:28:00Z' AND timestamp <= '2026-03-22T08:00:00Z'
```

sam: query returned 24 rows — matches DLQ count. closing incident after postmortem.

maria: followup actions: 1) Add encryption-context migration step to KMS rotation playbook. 2) Add audit-publisher DLQ alerting. 3) Add test in staging to rotate alias weekly to catch this.

sam: assigning follow-ups to infra+sec-eng. :white_check_mark:
